title: Installation event
description: What intake publishes on the installation-events topic (riffle-<environment>-installation-events in GCP) and the app consumes to run the tenant workflow (ADR 0025): an installation created, deleted, suspended or unsuspended, or repositories added to or removed from it. Signature verified and duplicates dropped. The ordering key is the tenant_id, so one installation's events arrive in order.

delivery_id.description: GitHub's X-GitHub-Delivery header. The tenant workflow is idempotent on it

action.description: GitHub's action. added and removed come with installation_repositories, the rest with installation

account_login.description: Organisation or user the App is installed on

repositories_added.description: Repositories the installation now covers: all of them on created, the new ones on added, otherwise empty

repositories_removed.description: Repositories taken out of the installation on removed, otherwise empty

received_at.description: When intake verified the delivery, RFC 3339 in UTC

id.description: GitHub repository id; stays the same when the repository is renamed
